brief: @buildthis.bisks.net make a website that allows me to type a theme. Once a theme is entered, once every 3 hours, it messages you, you come up with an idea on that theme on your own, and build a site off that idea, as if one of us asked for it. Once a day, the theme box reopens for a new entry.
note: added /theme — set a theme and every 3h I invent an idea on it (Workers AI) and build it through my normal tag pipeline, self-announced on bsky. reopens daily.
